requirements.R1: Beat column: every ZM3D beat players can see in the four beta buy weeks (a window, a reset or a start push); Boss Arena and Axe Arena are off this calendar, and so is Zombie Lane (a permanent track with no window or reset to plan, per Frederick's follow-up under his ask); the rotating shop is not a beat
requirements.R2: First window (UTC) column: a beat starts with the first window that opens after its server windows are live on prod (the backend release instant, read in UTC), not when its client PRs merged; Collect & Win's Mon-Tue / Wed-Thu / Fri-Sun windows open 00:00 UTC; every window closes 23:59 UTC on its last day
requirements.R3: Status column: a beat is held only when players provably cannot enter, score or claim on prod even after a restart (an established failure holds it, an unverified one does not), or when an in-scope live-ops PR (the Aug-Sep merged cohort) carries an unresolved change-request review blocker; a hold with no dated fix runs until the fix is confirmed on prod, and a held beat keeps its usual windows and weeks on its row, marked held; a beat whose server windows are waiting on the backend release starts late, it is not held; restart-clearing faults, wrong counters, cosmetic, VFX, performance and analytics gaps do not hold it, nor does a change-request outside the cohort window (e.g. the July #303)
requirements.R4: Weeks running column: which weeks a beat runs, All four weeks for the quest rollover and the daily gift; a one-off may take a recurring beat's slot only with Product's (Robert's) latest dated approval
requirements.R5: Still to do column: a closed list of what each beat still needs before it runs for bought users, with its owner: its fix if it is held, and anything flagged since the brief as still needed for it (prod deploy, config or player-facing art); nothing else goes in, so not what already shipped, not analytics, not polish nobody flagged
requirements.R6: Pushes tab: the push plan is the PNs Beta tab row by row, local notifications included, with the four rows for things that are not in the beta (Hourly Coins, Nathan's Treasure Hunt, Streak Fever, Axe Arena) left off; a push goes out only if its row is Ready and LIVE and the English copy on that row names the game as Zombie Match 3D and events by their ZM3D names (Login Calendar and Weekly Rankings are fine), and Frederick's follow-up adds that copy that names no game at all is fine (the naming rule is only about wrong names); anything else is held with which of those its row is missing
requirements.R7: Destinations: the calendar in Julia's calendar sheet, its link on the calendar ticket, a note on the ticket of a beat that ends up held so its owner picks it up, and the recommendation with tradeoffs as a reply in Frederick's DM
requirements.R8: Config locks: every config a beat needs lands before its lock, read in server time (UTC); a committed date that misses the lock moves to any time before it and you tell its owner in a reply on the mail where they committed to it
requirements.R9: Span: the four buy weeks Mon Oct 6 00:00 UTC - Sun Nov 2 23:59 UTC, with anything that starts before or runs past that clipped to those two instants and windows stated in server time (UTC); Endless goes down as its weekly windows, with the daily reset noted
